name: Nikutai Sousa
source:
"I've woken up...." Kazuki, an average student, has completely changed after he met a girl. What he's acquired is a power of controlling other people's bodies. It's just a tiny power at first, but it grows stronger.... One day, an evil idea strikes him when an accident happens. It soon dominates his heart and leads him to a road to destruction....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090708103306/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012663]ErogeShop[/url]]
